ui.natural_help_intro: Write an English sentence in the title. Recognized details fill the fields; the remaining text becomes the title.
ui.natural_help_dates: tomorrow · next Friday · in two business days · 12 Nov 2027 · 2027-11-12. Numeric dates use day/month.
ui.natural_help_times: at 9:30 · from 9 to 5pm · quarter to five in the afternoon. Times use your local timezone.
ui.natural_help_duration: for an hour and a half · for 1h30m · starts 12 Nov at 9am; ends 13 Nov at 5pm · all day.
ui.natural_help_location: at the office · at "Studio 54" · location: "Sofia, Bulgaria". Quote places containing dates or commas.
ui.natural_help_notes: notes: Bring ID · description: "Discuss tomorrow". Separate another field with a semicolon.
ui.natural_help_repeat: every Monday and Thursday · every other week on Friday · every last Friday of the month · for six occurrences · until 31 Dec 2027.
ui.natural_help_calendar: calendar: "Work" selects a writable calendar with that name.
ui.natural_help_status: status: done · status: open. Saving applies the selected status.
ui.natural_help_task_limit: Tasks store a due day, notes and status. Clock times and unsupported repeat phrases remain in the title.
ui.natural_help_event_edit_limit: Repeat rules and calendar selection are parsed for new events only. Use Google Calendar to change an existing series.
ui.natural_help_event_limit: A date without a time is all day. A time without a date means today. Morning, afternoon and evening alone use 09:00, 15:00 and 19:00.
ui.natural_help_manual: Manual field changes take priority. Quote literal title text to keep date words. Check the interpretation beneath the title before saving.
ui.where_the_card_s_headlines_come_from_bot: Where the card’s headlines come from. Both lists are kept, so switching this back changes nothing.
ui.the_feeds_added_below_or_a_feedly_accoun: The feeds added below, or a Feedly account.
ui.a_personal_access_token_from_feedly_com_: A personal access token from feedly.com/v3/auth/dev. Feedly issues one to Pro and Pro+ accounts and allows 50 calls a day on it, so the card reads once and reacts to the answer.
ui.the_token_feedly_shows_after_you_authori: The token Feedly shows after you authorise
ui.optional_feedly_shows_one_beside_the_tok: Optional. Feedly shows one beside the token.
ui.feedly_answers_with_the_account_the_toke: Feedly answers with the account and the plan it belongs to.
ui.the_subscription_file_every_feed_reader_: The subscription file every feed reader can export and read. Importing adds to this list and never replaces it.
ui.a_feed_already_in_the_list_is_skipped_an: A feed already in the list is skipped, and a new host shows the same Allow button a feed typed here does.
ui.add_a_feedly_token_in_settings_under_fee: Add a Feedly token in Settings, under Feeds.
ui.planning_placeholder: What do you want to get done?
ui.planning_natural_hint: Try “Call Mum tomorrow” or “Book tickets in 3 days”. English dates are supported.
ui.planning_error_ambiguous: Choose one day, or put the whole title in quotes to keep date words as text.
ui.planning_when_hint: Use a date, today, tomorrow or in 3 days. Leave blank for Later.
ui.planning_priority_hint: Choose up to three priorities for each day.
ui.planning_empty_day: Add a task, or choose something from Later.
ui.planning_empty_later: Keep ideas and tasks here until you are ready to plan them.
ui.planning_earlier_hint: Bring forward what still matters. Nothing is moved into today automatically.
ui.planning_error_changed: This plan changed in another tab. Reopen the task and try again.
ui.planning_error_damaged: Planning data could not be read and has been left unchanged. Restore a valid backup in Settings.
ui.planning_error_limit: Planning holds up to 500 tasks. Delete finished tasks you no longer need before adding more.
ui.planning_error_priority: Choose up to three priorities for a day. Unstar one before choosing another.
ui.planning_error_save: The task could not be saved. Your saved plan has been left unchanged. Try again.
ui.planning_error_date: Enter a date, today, tomorrow or in 3 days, or leave the date blank for Later.
ui.planning_about_hint: Capture tasks in the widget, choose a day, and pick up to three priorities. Plans stay on this device and are included in Moo backups.
ui.planning_budget_hint: Optional time to set aside each day. Estimates are compared with this target; use 0 for no target.
ui.planning_history_hint: Completed tasks from all days will be deleted. Unfinished tasks are kept. This cannot be undone.
ui.planning_natural_help_intro: Type a task and an English date. The preview shows the title and planned day before you add it.
ui.planning_natural_help_limit: Planning reads dates. Add notes, time estimates and priorities in the task editor.
ui.planning_natural_help_manual: Without a date, the selected day or Later is used. Put the whole title in double quotes to keep date words as text.
ui.drive_setup: Enable the Drive API in your Google Cloud project, then connect Google again to allow read-only access to file metadata. Moo does not read file contents or change files.
ui.drive_empty: No files found. Try another view or file name.
ui.drive_incomplete: Google returned a partial search. Narrow the file name or browse a folder.
ui.drive_reconnect: Reconnect Google to approve the new Drive metadata permission.
ui.subscriptions_about: Keep track of renewals and trials
ui.subscriptions_about_hint: Record your services, costs and cancellation dates. Everything stays in this browser and is included in Backups.
ui.subscriptions_invalid: Check the price, currency, renewal date and website address. Dates can be typed in English.
ui.subscriptions_manual_hint: Dates accept today, tomorrow, in 30 days or YYYY-MM-DD. Enter the price charged each cycle, including any tax you want counted.
ui.subscriptions_logo_hint: The catalogue searches locally. Common logos are bundled; other artwork loads from Dashboard Icons on GitHub when online.
ui.subscriptions_trial_ended: Trial date passed. Check whether the service started billing.
ui.subscriptions_check_renewal: Renewal date passed. Confirm the renewal or update the date.
ui.subscriptions_totals_hint: Active plans only. Monthly/yearly equivalents; currencies stay separate.
ui.subscriptions_empty: Add a service to track its next renewal or trial.
ui.subscriptions_tracking_only: Tracking only. Manage or cancel with the service itself.
ui.subscriptions_currency_hint: Use a three-letter currency code, such as EUR, USD or GBP.
ui.subscriptions_remote_hint: Allow logo images from raw.githubusercontent.com. Turn off to use bundled logos and initials only.
ui.subscriptions_error_changed: This subscription changed in another tab. Close and reopen it before editing.
ui.subscriptions_error_damaged: Saved subscriptions could not be read. Restore a valid backup to continue.
ui.subscriptions_error_limit: Up to 200 subscriptions can be stored. Remove an old entry before adding another.
ui.subscriptions_error_save: The change could not be saved. Check the entry and available browser storage.
